description: Import a text-based PDF exported from Canva or LinkedIn, LinkedIn CSV files, or plain text. Files are processed in this browser. The original design is not copied; review the information and choose a template in the editor.
file: PDF, text or LinkedIn CSV files
fileHint: PDF: up to 10 MB / 20 pages. CSV: Profile, Positions, Education, Skills and Languages files. Scanned PDFs require text recognition first.
reviewNote: Automatic field mapping can make mistakes. Uncertain dates and employers stay blank for you to correct in the next steps. Existing resumes are unchanged at this stage.
error: The file could not be read. Check its format and size, or paste the text manually.
noText: This PDF has no extractable text. Paste the text manually or run OCR first.
githubDescription: Connect GitHub with read-only access. Select from your public repositories and append them to the Projects section of a resume you choose.
githubUnavailable: GitHub integration is not enabled yet.
githubAdd: Add selected projects to the resume
githubError: The request failed. Check your connection; retry if the resume changed in another tab.
noResumes: Create a resume first, then add your projects.
csvReady: CSV fields have been mapped. Review before saving.
